title: Module global sections after algebraically closed scalar extension
statement: Let k be algebraically closed, K/k any field extension, X any k-scheme, n any natural number, and G an etale sheaf of ULift(Z/n)-modules on X. The canonical restriction of module global sections along X_K -> X is an isomorphism. No torsion-invertibility or qcqs condition is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 59.39.5, with the concrete coefficient inverse-image comparison

proof.text: Apply the canonical module-to-set inverse-image comparison, whose adjoint transpose is invertible. Its hom-equivalence factorization identifies the forgotten module unit at the identity etale object with the composite of the set unit and this comparison.

Install the given structure morphism f as X.Over(Spec k). The algebraically closed field k is separably closed, so apply set-valued sections invariance to the underlying set sheaf. Compose its bijective unit with the invertible comparison component to obtain a bijective module unit at the identity etale object.

Reflect bijectivity to a module isomorphism. Transport the component from the identity etale object to the chosen terminal object by naturality and their terminal isomorphism. Unfold globalSectionsUpperStarMap; its remaining factors are isomorphisms, so the full composite is invertible.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A3I, with the fully proved canonical coefficient comparison and adjunction unit factorization.

theorem isIso_globalSectionsUpperStarMap_algClosed_extension
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [IsAlgClosed k] [Algebra k K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (n : ℕ)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))) :
    IsIso (globalSectionsUpperStarMap
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) G)
